evidence.title: Trump administration to assign government lawyers to migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Wendy Young's statement and HHS organizational records
occurrences.quote_span: Wendy Young, president of Kids in Need of Defense, a nonprofit that provides free legal representation and social services to unaccompanied children, called the creation of the new in-house HHS legal team “part of a pattern of attacks that this administration has engaged in, in terms of undermining zealous representation of unaccompanied children in their immigration proceedings.”
occurrences.speaker: Wendy Young
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Shaina Aber's public statement and HHS custody and legal-services organizational records
occurrences.quote_span: “Placing children’s legal representation and services inside of the same agency that holds children in federal immigration custody is an unprecedented step that does not meet basic standards of independence of counsel,” Aber said.
occurrences.speaker: Shaina Aber
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Employment records for the child lawyer, immigration judge and government deportation attorneys
occurrences.quote_span: But Young noted that the child’s lawyer, the judge, and government attorneys seeking deportation will all be federal employees.
occurrences.speaker: Wendy Young
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal contract award records for Our Rescue
occurrences.quote_span: The government recently awarded a contract to another organization, Our Rescue, with a potential value of up to $244 million.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Sui Chung's statement and immigration-court attorney-of-record records
occurrences.quote_span: “To deny legal counsel to the most vulnerable among us — children who have already fled trauma — is a fundamental breakdown of the fairness our Constitution promises,” Chung said. “Children deserve our strongest protection.”
occurrences.speaker: Sui Chung
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS and Acacia Center for Justice contract and case-management records
occurrences.quote_span: It comes after the administration cut ties with the Acacia Center for Justice, a nongovernmental organization that managed 24,000 cases and held a contract to provide representation through a vast network of legal service providers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS organizational and staffing records for the legal representation division
occurrences.quote_span: The Trump administration is creating a team of attorneys to represent children who traveled alone to the United States in immigration proceedings, which critics say would deprive them of having lawyers who aren’t employed by the government and could put them at greater risk of deportation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS organizational directives and Office of Refugee Resettlement custody records
occurrences.quote_span: The new division will work independently from other government agencies that deal with the minors, including the HHS Office of Refugee Resettlement, which is responsible for the custody and care of the children who arrive in the U.S. without a parent or legal guardian.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal procurement records and Acacia legal challenge filings
occurrences.quote_span: The transition to Our Rescue, which has been challenged by Acacia, has led to short-term arrangements, including a temporary contract with the U.S. Committee for Refugees and Immigrants.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS statement and organizational records for the Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division
occurrences.quote_span: Health and Human Services said in a statement that its Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division will work under its general counsel’s direction toward “safely reuniting these children with their families and ensuring they have the legal support they need.”
occurrences.speaker: Health and Human Services
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal Register announcement signed by HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.quote_span: The U.S. Health and Human Services Department lawyers will “provide direct legal advice and counsel” to unaccompanied migrant children, according to an announcement in the Federal Register signed by Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.speaker: Federal Register announcement signed by Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children

occurrences.checkable_against: Americans for Immigrant Justice caseload, staffing and attorney-availability records
occurrences.quote_span: Sui Chung, the group’s executive director, said the need for legal representation exceeds the available resources.
occurrences.speaker: Sui Chung
occurrences.subject: HHS legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children
